items.subject: Your 2025 paper citing my 2017 photonics paper
items.body:
Hi Azalia,

I'm Nicholas Harris from Lightmatter. A 2025 paper listing you, with Google as your affiliation as of September 2025, cites my 2017 paper, Deep learning with coherent nanophotonic circuits.

Separately, a cached search finds 2 Google papers since 25 August 2026 matching photonic and optical interconnect terms. Would you be open to a short call about whether this research could be relevant to your team? A plain no is fine.

Nicholas
